CustomField.description: Registration number in a grid operator's Installateurverzeichnis. NAV §13(2) allows work behind the house fuse only by a registered company, so this is the legal gate on installation work, not a nice-to-have. Registration is company-level and held by exactly ONE grid operator (BDEW/ZVEH Grundsätze §2.1.3), and one entry is valid nationwide (§2.2.6) - which is why this is a single field and not a junction to every DSO.
CustomField.label: Installateurverzeichnis-Nr.
